(4) Reachability: u1 is reachable from u0 via box_fell and uF is reachable both directly and through u1 -> u0 -> uF; the u1 -> u0 recovery is always executable because every fall turns the agent to face the box, so the next pickup succeeds. (5) Compactness: three states is minimal for expressing the recovery subgoal plus the terminal goal state. (6) Format: REWARD_MACHINE/STATES/INITIAL_STATE/FINAL_STATES/TRANSITION_FUNCTION/REWARD_FUNCTION headers, transition tuples (state, label) -> target with ordered guards and terminating else per state, and reward tuples (source, label, target) -> value all follow the paper layout; FINAL_STATES is nonempty (uF), uF is declared in STATES and is accepting as the rewarded goal transition target. Accepted.

def siren_ringing(env): return env.siren_ringing

def switch_toggled(env): return "toggle" in env.events_this_step

def holding_box(env): return env.carrying is not None and env.carrying.type == "box"

def box_fell(env): return "fall" in env.events_this_step

def at_exit(env): return env.grid.get(env.agent_pos[0], env.agent_pos[1]) is not None and env.grid.get(env.agent_pos[0], env.agent_pos[1]).type == "goal"
